html:
Ben Tre looks like a green island floating in the middle of the river, a destination for tourists who love to explore the West, especially when traveling to the West during the flood season.

When is the best time to travel to Ben Tre?

Ben Tre has a warm and sunny climate all year round, visitors can come here at any time of the year, however, the best time to travel to Ben Tre is in the summer from June to August, this is an opportunity for visitors to admire the picture of Ben Tre, and enjoy delicious fruits such as: mangosteen, durian, rambutan…

Points of interest in Ben Tre

Con Quy is famous for its delicious fruits, shrimp and fish, Con Quy is a garden area of ​​the Mekong Delta, coming to Con Quy, visitors not only visit beautiful landscapes but also enjoy delicious dishes.

Con Phung is located on an island floating in the middle of Tien River. When coming here, visitors can experience the motorboats along Con Phung to see the scenery and visit the coconut candy production facility, and buy souvenirs made from coconuts during the Mekong tour. Especially, sitting next to the thatched house enjoying honey tea, and fishing will bring visitors the most enjoyable experiences during their vacation in the river area.

The fruit garden, visitors can pick ripe fruits and enjoy them on the spot, there is nothing more interesting than this place, each season will bring its own fruit.

Coconut garden: Ben Tre coconut is famous for its beautiful scenery. When coming here, visitors can experience the boat to see the scenery or take a car to see the peaceful scenery with the cool breeze.

Vam Ho bird sanctuary is home to many species of birds, there are rare birds coming here to live, visitors can save beautiful pictures for themselves.

The tomb of Nguyen Dinh Chieu is the resting place of the great poet of the nation. If you travel to Ben Tre on July 1st every year, you will be able to join the traditional festival to commemorate the famous poet, the son of the South.

Binh Dai beach is still quite wild, although not as crowded as other places, Binh Dai beach has its own beauty or visit spiritual tourist attractions, and enjoy fresh seafood, especially the fishing experience will bring visitors a sense of excitement.

Dong Khoi Guerrilla Village is where exhibitions often take place, and is also a place to display primitive weapons that Ben Tre people used to make weapons during the resistance war.

Craft villages, in Ben Tre there are many craft villages such as: Phu Le craft village, My Long rice paper craft village, Son Doc rice paper craft village, weaving craft village… tourists not only visit the scenery but also visit traditional craft villages and enjoy the peaceful scenery.

So if you have the opportunity to go on a Mekong tour, visitors should experience a sampan running through rows of water coconut trees growing around the canal banks, a cool and poetic scene.
